identity.title: [tooling][csdlc-v2] Implemented-phase card recovery cannot repair review-blocking SPP/STP truth

values.summary: #400 implemented and validated a narrow typed C-SDLC v2 recovery route for implemented-phase STP dependency truth and SPP plan-step status truth after recorded review recovery. The final recovery keeps SPP plan-step repair status-only: step IDs, actions, acceptance IDs, and step cardinality must remain identical to prior SPP truth.
actual_changes: Added typed semantic operation correct_stp_dependencies_after_recovery for STP dependency denominator repairs.
Added typed semantic operation correct_plan_steps_after_recovery for SPP execution-step status repairs.
Gated both operations on implemented phase plus current recorded-review recovery provenance with cleared review/publication/readiness/terminal truth.
Recorded audit snapshots for previous/new STP dependencies or SPP steps and the associated recovery sequence/generation.
Restricted correct_plan_steps_after_recovery to status-only changes by rejecting changed step IDs, changed actions, changed acceptance IDs, and changed step cardinality.
Added independent gate5 negative regressions for SPP step id mutation and acceptance_ids mutation after review recovery finding fresh-session:e647ddf0-0564-475d-becb-210208f0cf1d.
Retained full gate5 regression proof under .csdlc/evidence/400/gate5-full.log after the earlier full-denominator proof-retention finding.
